background.css: radial-gradient(50% 30% at 50% 100%, rgba(255,62,165,.14), transparent 70%), repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(53,224,232,.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 44px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(53,224,232,.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 44px), linear-gradient(180deg, #1a0b38 0%, #14082b 55%, #200a42 100%)

mood: A 1985 arcade cabinet at midnight: deep violet ground with a faint cyan perspective grid and a magenta horizon-glow rising from the bottom of the screen. Two neons — magenta (--accent) and cyan (--ty) — and they never blend. Signatures to reproduce structurally: (1) chapter titles are condensed, uppercase, wide-tracked, with a restrained neon halo (text-shadow in the accent hue, one soft layer, no blinking); (2) progress through the book is gamified visually — the TOC styles chapters as LEVEL 01 … LEVEL NN, and each page footer shows a pixel-block progress bar (repeating-linear-gradient squares) filled to the reader's position; (3) asides are 'INSERT COIN' interstitials: a 2px neon-bordered panel, square corners, title in mono uppercase; (4) key stats or scores render in a chunky mono with leading zeros (SCORE 000420). Keep body text quiet and highly readable — the neon lives in the chrome, never the paragraphs. The feel: serious content wearing a great synthwave jacket.
name: Arcade
tagline: Synthwave cabinet — neon horizon, pixel progress, LEVEL 01
